d:
Celebrate the bond of siblings with "Behna Ne Bhai Ki Kalai Se" from Resham Ki Dori (1974), beautifully sung by Suman Kalyanpur. Composed by Shankar-Jaikishan with heartfelt lyrics by Indeevar, this touching song celebrates the sacred thread of Raksha Bandhan, featuring Dharmendra and Saira Banu.

Song: Behna Ne Bhai Ki Kalai Se
Movie: Resham Ki Dori (1974)

Music Director: Shankar-Jaikishan
Lyricist: Indeevar
